completion.total_credits_note: comprised of 0.5 credit of ISP100H5 and 4.0 credits in FAS courses and 4.0 credits in FAH or VCC or VST courses offered at UTM (see detailed notes below). The following program structure is highly recommended:

items.description: First Year: 1. FAH101H5 and ISP100H5 2. 0.5 additional credit in FAH at the 200 level 2. 2.0 credits from FAS143H5 or FAS145H5 or FAS147H5 or FAS232H5 or FAS236H5 or FAS248H5 (All of these courses are open to first-year students.)
items.subject: FAH

items.description: Second Year: 1. Remaining uncompleted credit(s) from the FAS course list identified in ‘First Year’ (above). 2. 2.0 credit of FAH at the 200 level
items.subject: FAH

items.description: Third & Fourth Years: 1. 1.0 credit of FAH or VCC or VST at the 300/400 level 2. 1.0 credit of FAS at the 300/400 level
items.subject: VST

items.text: Students must take at least 2.0 credits, but no more than 2.5 credits, of FAH at the 200 level, of which 2.0 credits must be completed at UTM (see Note 3 below for the required area distribution and Note 4 below for the St. George exceptions allowed). VCC 200 level courses do not satisfy FAH 200 level requirements.

items.description: At least 0.5 credit of FAH must be completed in each of the following three areas : Ancient & Medieval; 15th-18th Centuries; and 19th-21st Centuries. See the departmental website ( www.utm.utoronto.ca/dvs ) for the distribution of courses by area.
items.subject: FAH

sub_constraints.description: FAH must be completed in each of the following three areas : Ancient & Medieval; 15th-18th Centuries; and 19th-21st Centuries

items.description: 0.5 credit of FAH at the 200 level may be taken at St. George in an area not covered by current UTM offerings (i.e. one of the following courses – FAH248H1 or FAH260H1 or FAH262H1 or FAH270H1 or FAH272H1 ).
items.subject: FAH

items.text: For the complete list of VCC courses that satisfy Art & Art History program requirements, please see the departmental website ( www.utm.utoronto.ca/dvs ).

As studio space is limited in the 100-level and 200-level FAS courses, priority will be given during the first registration period to students enrolled in the Art & Art History Major or Specialist, Art History Major or Specialist, CCIT Major, VCC Specialist, and to newly admitted students who indicated the Art & Art History code on their application. Students committed to the program should make sure that they are officially registered in the program as soon as possible.

items.description: All 300 and 400 level FAS courses are to be enrolled in on ACORN. Students are required to have completed 1.5 credits in FAH or VCC before beginning their 300/400 level FAS courses.
items.subject: FAH

items.description: No more than 13.0 credits of FAH and FAS may be completed.
items.subject: FAH

sub_constraints.description: FAH and FAS may be completed

items.text: Students enrolling in any FAS course will be required to pay a fee of $60-$120 per half-credit course ($120-$240 per full-credit course) in ancillary fees to cover consumable materials used in studio as well as take-away materials. These charges will be automatically added to UofT student account upon enrolment in the course on ACORN. For details on ancillary fees, please see the Student Accounts website ( www.fees.utoronto.ca ).
